main.description: Extended metadata for an organization actor. Complements the base actor profile (app.certified.actor.profile), which holds the display name, description, website, avatar, and banner, with organization-specific fields such as legal name, full logo, public contact email, legal structure, reference links, and locations.

legalName.description: The organization's registered legal name (e.g. 'Acme Social Enterprises Ltd.'), where it differs from the public-facing name. The public-facing name belongs in app.certified.actor.profile displayName.

logo.description: The organization's full logo: a wordmark, or a combination mark pairing the symbol with the name. Used where the logo appears without the name beside it, such as partner listings or badge displays. Prefer a horizontal image with a transparent background (PNG or WebP). The square symbol alone (brandmark) belongs in app.certified.actor.profile avatar, which is cropped to a square or circle.

publicEmail.description: A contact email address the organization wants shown publicly (e.g. 'hello@example.org'). Records are public, so never put a personal or internal address here.

organizationType.description: Legal or operational structures of the organization (e.g. 'nonprofit', 'ngo', 'government', 'social-enterprise', 'cooperative').

urls.description: Additional reference URLs, each with a display label: social media profiles, contact pages, donation links, and similar. The organization's main website belongs in app.certified.actor.profile website, not here.

location.description: A strong reference to the organization's primary location: where it is based, and where it is shown when a map displays one point per organization. The referenced record must conform with the lexicon app.certified.location. Because a strong reference pins a specific version (CID) of that record, update this reference whenever the location record is edited. Further locations go in additionalLocations.

additionalLocations.description: Strong references to further locations where the organization operates, such as branches, outlets, or field offices. Excludes the primary location, which is in location; do not repeat it here. Each referenced record must conform with the lexicon app.certified.location. As with location, update a reference whenever its record is edited.

foundedDate.description: When the organization was established. Stored as datetime per ATProto conventions (no date-only format exists). Clients should use midnight UTC (e.g., '2005-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'); consumers should treat only the date portion as canonical.

longDescription.description: Long-form description of the organization, such as its mission, history, or detailed project narrative. An inline string for plain text or markdown, a Leaflet linear document record embedded directly, or a strong reference to an existing document record.

visibility.description: Controls whether the organization or project is publicly discoverable on platforms that honor this setting.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when this record was originally created.

signatures.description: Optional cryptographic signatures attesting to this record's content.

label.description: Optional human-readable label for this URL (e.g. 'LinkedIn', 'Instagram', 'Donation page').
